findings.text: `source < existing_source` compares two `ParameterSource` members. In click, `ParameterSource` is a plain `enum.Enum` with no ordering, so `<` raises `TypeError`. It runs whenever a second parameter shares a name, as in a feature-switch group such as `--a/--b` with the same dest. Both options then crash with `TypeError: '<' not supported` instead of resolving the slot. I could not find the enum definition in the patch directory, so this rests on click's standard definition.

`same_source` now lets a later parameter overwrite an earlier one. Previously the first parameter to set the slot won. With two shared-name flags that both fall back to DEFAULT, or both read from the environment, the last-processed option's value now wins, and that value can be the wrong default. This changes existing feature-switch behavior.
